blind.description: A stylized wooden china cabinet or hutch with an open front displaying dishware. It features a lower two-door solid cabinet section with gold knobs, standing on four small molded bracket feet. The upper display section has two glass-paned doors that are swung open, revealing three interior shelves stocked with ceramic tableware including stacks of plates, a pitcher, bowls, and a lidded tureen. The top features a decorative carved crown molding with a central golden finial/crest accent. The wood is a warm polished brown tone with stylized painted highlights, and the dishes are ivory/cream with subtle glazed patterns. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and well-modeled without floating or broken parts.
blind.from_above: A rectangular brown top with a recessed flat center surrounded by an ornate decorative raised rim and scrolled crest at the front, with the two open glass doors protruding forward at different angles (one swung wide to the left, one projecting forward to the right).
blind.height_vs_figure: About 90% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 5 ft 2 in tall), and roughly 3 to 3.5 feet wide across the crown molding.
